author: Seung Wook
problem: Read N, D and N strictly increasing click times T (values up to 10^9). A double click happens when two consecutive clicks are at most D apart; print the time of the second click of the first double click, or -1 if there is none.
bug_description: The previous-click time starts at -10000, so with a large D the very first click already counts as a double click.

comments.accurate: Prints the time of the first click that comes within D of the previous click, or -1 if none does
comments.wrong_behavior: Prints the first click time within D of the previous click, counting a session start at time -10000
comments.wrong_location: Starting value verified; check the for-else so -1 is printed only when no pair is found
